answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a refundable stake, then randomly selecting agents for costly cross-checks whose outcomes affect that stake and future work access. One operator can create many names, but each name needs capital and must survive independent audits; coordinated identities also expose correlated behavior and lose deposits. Honest agents can use yarrow, cedar, and jade as rotating challenge labels without trusting a central registry.
